separate_targets: Load and PV always have separate historical references or separately fitted models, own coefficients and error metrics; combine only for dispatch and net-error risk allowance
data_version: prepared-v1 unchanged; raw source_date + source_minute is interval start, duration 1/6 h
q1_status: User explicitly retained Q1 and now authorizes Q2 trials. initialization.first_day_order: retained Q1 C04.csv purchase_kwh; no reoptimization
initialization.missing_first_actual_interval: Only Jan1 00:00 simulation interval uses annex1 midnight load/PV as labelled initialization reference; never included as measured training target; all later intervals are actual annex2
initialization.common_january_policy: T1 fixed one matching weekday and PV last3 days; insufficient same weekday uses available prior days; only no available same-slot history uses annex1 reference, logged. This replaces the old proposed yesterday-only warmup and is not an extra compared candidate.
initialization.common_feb1_storage: actual end storage of shared Jan trajectory; never set independently to6000

planner.objective: forecast ordinary bill minus terminal inventory reference value; T4 replaces forecast load with load plus historical allowance; accounting uses only true ordinary plus emergency bills

controller: PV direct supply first. Compare remaining load with locked ordinary q; if deficit, discharge as feasible then emergency at5p. If surplus, charge within power/capacity, using PV surplus before remaining ordinary; unused ordinary still paid. No simultaneous charge/discharge, no sales, no emergency charging. Current-interval feedback is a within-interval power-balancing approximation using realized interval power, not advance information for midnight planning.

timing.subsequent_period: Jul-Dec not dispatched in this batch, already viewed in EDA so no untouched-test claim
timing.parameter_selection: by January actual total cost with common Jan8 start and own continuous trajectory; selection is made Jan31 after outcomes, never backdates selected parameters into real Jan decisions

T1.weights: equal1/n over available selected dates; no entropy weighting

T2.features: target time sin/cos first2harmonics, seven weekday indicators, horizon1/2, day-of-year sin/cos, recent same-slot last/mean3/mean7, target matching-week1/4, recent daily level last/mean7; target-specific histories only
T2.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on eligible training samples

T3.features_and_training: same target-specific features/window/cutoffs as T2, no scaling needed
T3.weights: equal sample loss weights; learned tree splits/leaves with fixed boosting step, not entropy-derived feature weights

prediction_domain: Nonnegative load/PV forecasts. PV zero if that time had no positive PV in any observed previous28days; historical support only, not today's true daylight; disclosed possible sunrise-season lag. No clipping of true values.

T4.error: actual load-PV minus causally reconstructed T1 forecast load-PV in kWh per10min
T4.group: 4hour-of-day groups with>=14historical days; 7-13days pool all hours; <7days no allowance
T4.calculation: quantile of all signed errors, then max(value,0); equal historical samples, no dropping negative errors; same margin groups for both future days

selection: Compare actual ordinary+emergency cost first, interpret error by target/month/daytype, emergency duration, unreceived ordinary, unusedPV, boundary storage and complexity. No entropy-weighted artificial aggregate score. User requested evidence-based main recommendation; it is provisional to this batch, not a freeze or annual validation.
outputs: Protocol/source hashes; causal forecast and training metadata; coefficients/history weights/risk levels; orders/actual and expected48h trajectories; daily/period metrics; solver residuals and independent readback; four-candidate report, explanation and paper evidence. No result2 template filling, no Q3, no automatic deeper experiments.
stop: Stop affected run on time leakage/physical or source inconsistency. Otherwise deliver evidence and selected recommendation, with remaining validation needs. No invented approvals or Q1/Q2 freeze.
